passages.text: Then the angel showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, with Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the high priest of Israel.
The angel showed me Joshua.
Joshua stood before the angel of the LORD.
Satan stood at Joshua’s right hand.
Satan stood there to accuse Joshua.
passages.original: וַיַּרְאֵ֗נִי אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל עֹמֵ֕ד לִפְנֵ֖י מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וְהַשָּׂטָ֛ן עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־ יְמִינ֖וֹ לְשִׂטְנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to Satan: “The LORD rebukes you, Satan! Indeed, the LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebukes you! Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Satan.
The LORD said, “The LORD rebukes you, Satan.”
The LORD has chosen Jerusalem.
The LORD said, “The LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebukes you.”
This man stands here.
This man is like a burning stick pulled out of the fire.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֗ן יִגְעַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה בְּךָ֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן וְיִגְעַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּךָ֔ הַבֹּחֵ֖ר בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲל֧וֹא זֶ֦ה א֖וּד מֻצָּ֥ל מֵאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy garments as he stood before the angel.
passages.sermon: Joshua was the high priest.\r\nJoshua wore filthy clothes.\r\nJoshua stood before the angel.
passages.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֕עַ הָיָ֥ה לָבֻ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים צוֹאִ֑ים וְעֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י הַמַּלְאָֽךְ׃

passages.text: So the angel said to those standing before him, “Take off his filthy clothes!” Then he said to Joshua, “See, I have removed your iniquity, and I will clothe you with splendid robes.”
passages.sermon:
The angel stood before Joshua.
The angel spoke to the people standing near him.
The angel gave them a command.
He said, “Take off his filthy clothes.”
The angel then spoke directly to Joshua.
He said, “See, I have removed your iniquity from you.”
He said, “I will clothe you with splendid robes.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־ הָעֹמְדִ֤ים לְפָנָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָסִ֛ירוּ הַבְּגָדִ֥ים הַצֹּאִ֖ים מֵעָלָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו רְאֵ֨ה הֶעֱבַ֤רְתִּי מֵעָלֶ֙יךָ֙ עֲוֺנֶ֔ךָ וְהַלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֹתְךָ֖ מַחֲלָצֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So a clean turban was placed on his head, and they clothed him, as the angel of the LORD stood by.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the high priest.
He stood before the angel of the LORD.
I spoke and said, “Put a clean turban on his head.”
They put a clean turban on Joshua’s head.
They clothed Joshua in new garments.
The angel of the LORD stood nearby.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר יָשִׂ֛ימוּ צָנִ֥יף טָה֖וֹר עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיָּשִׂימוּ֩ הַצָּנִ֨יף הַטָּה֜וֹר עַל־ רֹאשׁ֗וֹ וַיַּלְבִּשֻׁ֙הוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֔ים וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה עֹמֵֽד׃

passages.text: Then the angel of the LORD gave this charge to Joshua: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘If you walk in My ways and keep My instructions, then you will govern My house and will also have charge of My courts; and I will give you a place among these who are standing here.
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke to Joshua.
The angel gave Joshua a command.
The LORD of Hosts spoke through the angel.
The LORD of Hosts said these words.
“If you walk in My ways, you will follow My path.
If you keep My instructions, you will obey My commands.
Then you will govern My house.
You will have charge of My courts.
I will give you a place among these who are standing here.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֙עַד֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה בִּיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אִם־ בִּדְרָכַ֤י תֵּלֵךְ֙ וְאִ֣ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֔ר וְגַם־ אַתָּה֙ תָּדִ֣ין אֶת־ בֵּיתִ֔י וְגַ֖ם תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר אֶת־ חֲצֵרָ֑י וְנָתַתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ מַהְלְכִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָעֹמְדִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Hear now, O high priest Joshua, you and your companions seated before you, who are indeed a sign. For behold, I am going to bring My servant, the Branch.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the high priest.
Joshua had companions sitting before him.
The angel spoke to Joshua and his companions.
The angel said they were a sign.
The angel said, “Listen now, Joshua the high priest, and your companions who sit before you.
You are men who are a sign.
I am going to bring My servant, the Branch.”
passages.original: שְֽׁמַֽע־ נָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ׀ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְרֵעֶ֙יךָ֙ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מוֹפֵ֖ת הֵ֑מָּה כִּֽי־ הִנְנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא אֶת־ עַבְדִּ֖י צֶֽמַח׃

passages.text: See the stone I have set before Joshua; on that one stone are seven eyes. Behold, I will engrave on it an inscription, declares the LORD of Hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of this land in a single day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He has set a stone before Joshua.
This stone is special.
This stone has seven eyes on it.
The LORD of Hosts will engrave an inscription on this stone.
The LORD of Hosts will remove the iniquity of this land in one day.
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ הִנֵּ֣ה הָאֶ֗בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַ֙תִּי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עַל־ אֶ֥בֶן אַחַ֖ת שִׁבְעָ֣ה עֵינָ֑יִם הִנְנִ֧י מְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתֻּחָ֗הּ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּמַשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־ עֲוֺ֥ן הָאָֽרֶץ־ הַהִ֖יא בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, you will each invite your neighbor to sit under your own vine and fig tree.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He makes a promise about a special day.
On that day, each person will invite his neighbor.
Each person will say, “Come and sit with me.”
They will sit together under their own vine.
They will also sit together under their own fig tree.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת תִּקְרְא֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ אֶל־ תַּ֥חַת גֶּ֖פֶן וְאֶל־ תַּ֥חַת תְּאֵנָֽה׃
